target_customer: Brands and manufacturers wanting to sell on multiple geographies and marketplaces
problem: Expanding to other marketplaces is complex and resource intensive; omnidock acts as merchant of record using pre-vetted marketplace accounts and handles transactions.
business_model: Merchant of record marketplace expansion service, take rate on sales (not stated in sources)

founders.name: Shayan Zakerzadeh
founders.background_notes: Started selling online at age 15 per YC profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: Catalog ingestion, eligibility assessment and automated listing are standard engineering, while the hard parts are operational: marketplace accounts, local entities and logistics.

defensibility.rationale: Pre-vetted marketplace accounts and local entities are operational assets that are slow to replicate, but platforms control access.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against omnidock found in sources.

market_need_then: Founders came from Razor Group, an aggregator that expanded across marketplaces, so the pain was first hand; no dated external demand data was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B voice: making multi-marketplace selling effortless

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand asset evidence; other companies hold OMNIDOCK trademarks in unrelated fields.

outcome_analysis: Omnidock launched after YC Summer 2024 with two founders who had worked at Razor Group, giving direct marketplace expansion experience. It is listed active with a very small team, no verified round beyond the YC deal and no exit or shutdown news, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: CB Insights reports $500K convertible note (2024-08-28); VCBacked lists a seed in November 2024 with Y Combinator, Team Ignite Ventures and altitude; Dealroom shows about $125K. Sources conflict and are aggregators only, so no round recorded. CB Insights lists a third founder, Christian Kohrs, but the YC page does not, so he is not listed here. The company site fetch gave only a short description. Competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 comparisons, so the list is empty.
